base.description: Preview host base override (`gpui-kit`, `iced`, `ratatui`, …). Empty → the document's own `base:`. Each unique (doc, base) pane gets its own preview host.

doc.description: Document to preview — a doc-relative `.forge.yaml` path, or a named ref (`name: &name`) holding a head-less node body. Empty → the host sets the document.

mode.description: `embedded` → the host window floats over a transparent slot (Studio's `frame_rect` tracking); `remote` (default) → the framed 'click to focus' card.

on click.description: Fired when the remote-preview card is clicked (e.g. to focus the host window).

placeholder.description: Shown while the host application has not set a document.

remote.description: Non-empty → the document previews in an out-of-process host; the element renders a framed card with this label instead of a nested view.
